description: Places a REAL phone call: the target number is dialled IMMEDIATELY and charged. Cannot be undone. Call this ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a call to be placed. agent_id and to_number are REQUIRED — never guess either one, never infer it from earlier conversation and never assign a default. Ask the user if anything is missing.

agent_id.description: Id of the assistant that will place the call. If unknown, call call2me_list_agents first.

from_number.description: Caller id (one of the account's numbers).

to_number.description: Number to dial, E.164 (+905551234567). The user must supply it explicitly.

name: call2me_make_outbound_call
title: Place a phone call
